body.description: Dronelet, a small living machine companion: a cute pocket quadcopter creature hovering, round body with one big camera lens eye, four small rotor arms with spinning props, antenna, scuffed white and orange paint
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
